description: A modular Python script for processing videos: loading from URL or local file, applying YOLOv8 models (detection, classification, pose) to frames, filtering for specific animal labels ('bear', 'dog', 'giraffe'), cropping detections, running classification and pose estimation on crops, and printing summarized results. It includes CLI arguments and environment variable support for flexible input sources.
